title: JsAnnouncement
description: A lightweight Minecraft Paper plugin for version all that allows server admins to send clean and configurable server announcements using simple commands. It provides easy-to-use announcement features with customizable title, subtitle, colors, and sound
body:
📢 AnnouncementPlugin

AnnouncementPlugin is a lightweight and powerful Minecraft Paper plugin designed to send customizable server announcements with ease. It allows server owners and admins to broadcast messages using a simple command system with fully configurable visuals and sounds.

✨ Features

✔ /announce <message> – Send server-wide announcements instantly
✔ /announce reload – Reload configuration without restarting server
✔ /announceauthor – Display plugin author and credits

✔ Custom Title & Subtitle support
✔ Fully configurable color codes using &
✔ XP orb sound effect on announcements
✔ Configurable fade-in, stay, and fade-out timings
✔ Lightweight and optimized for performance

⚙️ Configuration

Easily customize everything via config.yml:

Announcement title
Sound effects
Message colors
Animation timings
Author/credits message

No coding required.

💡 Example Usage
/announce Server restart in 5 minutes!

Broadcasts a styled announcement to all players with sound and title effect.

🎯 Perfect For
SMP servers
Minecraft networks
Hub servers
Community servers
Admin broadcast systems
🧑‍💻 Author
